name: 状態別の課題グループ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0002 状態別の課題グループ, a collapsible task group with its five rows.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL image1 controls all icon geometry, proportions, optical stroke weight, alignment, spacing, small control anatomy and details omitted by the mock. Japanese mock image2 is secondary for Japanese wording and overall compact layout; do not reproduce its rough substitute icons or uniform repeated metadata. Approved image3 provides white/forest-green/slate materials only, never bus imagery/content.
Preserve original header chevron, circular in-progress glyph, count5, far-right small plus, and exactly five task rows. Keep thin status circles matching original half-sector geometry; priority ascending bars on rows1-2, horizontal three-dot priority glyph on rows3-5. Assignee glyphs must match ORIGINAL tiny person in fine dotted circular perimeter, not a large sun/head drawing. Project document glyph on rows1-2, headset glyph on rows3-5, faithfully as original.
Japanese header 「進行中」 count「5」. Exact Japanese task wording from saved mock:
1「利用者の声を整理する」
2「課題と仮説を定義する」
3「教会の目標を書く」
4「対象となる人を整理する」
5「周辺の活動を調べる」
Restore original varied IDs as translated「作業-11」「作業-9」「作業-25」「作業-23」「作業-24」, rather than mock's repeated11.
Restore original per-row badges in Japanese: row1 white pills「調査」「礼拝改善」「利用者の理解と行動分析…」; row2 white pills「機能」「利用者の理解と行動分析…」「明日」 with small outline calendar on 明日; rows3,4,5 a white pill「調査支援」 with original headset glyph. These translate/adapt visible original information only. Dates follow original「3月31日」「3月31日」「4月1日」「4月1日」「4月1日」. No extra fields or rows.
Style: pure white #FFFFFF canvas, one compact rounded white group with very subtle neutral outline and soft downward shadow. Header white with fine divider. No broad gray or mint fill. Slate #526173 utility icons; green #1F6444 progress circles (adapt original yellow to brand green). Category markers coherent green dots and white pills; no random purple/cyan/orange icon colors. 明日 calendar can retain a restrained warm warning accent because original marks near-term scheduling, paired with Japanese text. Heading Meiryo Bold20/28, row body Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata Regular12/16, zero tracking; preserve relative sizes at960px logical width. Legible regular titles not all bold. Compact 5 evenly spaced rows, no clipping, exact Japanese. Landscape tightly framed component, no large margins, no invented primary action or gradient button. Raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画像全体と個別切抜き、日本語モック、正式方向を実見。原画像優先で棒/三点優先度、進行円、書類/ヘッドセット、担当者、展開/追加を復元。日本語五件、数5、識別子と期日を確認。黄色進行円は緑に、補助はスレート、明日の予定のみ原画像由来の暖色を維持。白面と控えめな境界/影。肉眼で欠落・文字切れ無し。厳密なフォント同一性や画素一致の証明ではない。エージェント目視確認、所有者承認・ネイティブ編集可能化・アプリ実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
